channel.title: The Indian Express - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Indian Express (indianexpress.com)

item.title: Remove encroachments near district court without delay: HC orders Lucknow Municipal Corporation
item.description: The civic body's inspection report listed 72 encroachments, mostly by advocates

item.title: Gujarat Confidential: Security ‘hassle’
item.description: Speaker Shankar Chaudhary said he would seek a report into the incident and inform the Vidhan Sabha later.

item.title: Women’s quota: Govt to take Opposition on board for hike in LS, Assembly seats
item.description: With Opposition seeking all-party meeting and a detailed brief before it, the government may take up matter only in a Special Session of Parliament after the Assembly polls

item.title: Gaps in prosecution story, discrepancy in complainant’s statements: Delhi HC acquits Sonu Punjaban, co-accused in 2014 trafficking case
item.description: The High Court flagged a procedural flaw in the way the trial court had permitted the prosecution to cross-examine the complainant, who was a prosecution witness.

item.title: Sleeping on footpaths, queueing at 2 am: The ordeal of Pune Jail constable recruitment aspirants
item.description: The recruitment advertisement was released in October 2025, and forms closed in November.

item.title: IGNOU extends assignment submission deadline for GOAL and EVBB June 2026 TEE
item.description: As per the notification, students are required to submit both hard copies and soft copies of their assignments. The university has clarified that the extended deadline is applicable to all students across ODL and online modes.

item.title: Notice to Centre on articles, books recovered during Op Blue Star: Why the debate persists
item.description: Govt and Army have consistently maintained that books and articles recovered during the operation at Golden Temple complex have been returned either to SGPC or Punjab govt

item.title: PMC cracks down on unauthorised overhead cables amid safety concerns
item.description: The PMC has appointed a private agency to identify unauthorised overhead cables in the city and it is only after the identification that the cables will be cut.

item.title: ‘What is your deep-rooted agenda?’: Supreme Court dismisses PIL challenging 2025 Air India Dreamliner crash report
item.description: The petitioner moved the Supreme Court after the Delhi High Court rejected his plea on February 25, 2026. He sought to "read down" the AAIB report on the crash of an Air India Boeing Dreamliner in Ahmedabad.

item.title: Reports on Karnataka Covid scam, ‘40% commission’ during BJP rule gather dust amid lobbying by politicians and officials
item.description: The Justice Michael D'Cunha commission has recommended action against former chief minister B S Yediyurappa and former health minister B Sriramulu.

item.title: Namita Thapar says she develops a ‘food baby’ on eatings toor dal khichdi instead of moong: ‘Pouch under your…’
item.description: If bloating is persistent, painful, or linked with other symptoms, it might be wise to consult a healthcare professional to rule out underlying digestive issues

item.title: Australian dream turns nightmare: Punjab and Haryana High Court denies pre-arrest bail in Rs 50 lakh kidnapping case
item.description: The Punjab and Haryana High Court was hearing the anticipatory bail of a travel agent who promised to send a man's 22-year-old son to Australia safely.

item.title: Bengaluru man tricks colleague’s mother with Gruhalakshmi dole promise, routes Rs 10 lakh through her account ‘for fraud’
item.description: Offering to secure a monthly dole Rs 2,000, Sangamesh asked the woman to open a new bank account and took Rs 12,000 for ‘processing formalities’.

item.title: Top 10 countries with the highest water quality: See where India ranks
item.description: Top 10 countries with the highest water quality list: The Environmental Performance Index (EPI) is one of the key benchmarks used to measure water quality worldwide. It assesses countries based on environmental health indicators, including access to safe drinking water and sanitation.

item.title: Cooper Connolly: Australia’s next batting star announces himself with stunning IPL debut
item.description: The 22-year-old Western Australian smashed 72 not out on debut, taking on Rashid Khan and Kagiso Rabada without flinching. Australian cricket may have found its next big thing.
